provenance.purpose: Headline run of the wide-context task formulation. Identical to configs/research_polarity_balanced_scaled_2ep_qwen3b_v1.json (prose discordant 0.4333) except context_lines=32 and max_seq_length 2048.
provenance.NOTE_identical_cells: The four (gold x net-sign) cells are computed from the +/- lines, which context width does not touch. This training set therefore selects the SAME 2208 pairs as the narrow-context run; only their rendered text is wider.
provenance.CAVEAT_crossvul: CrossVul non-held-out pairs are training data, as in every balanced run in this repository.
